answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted reputation that accrues slowly, like a glacier carving a valley: a new agent starts with near-zero weight and must complete many small, verifiable jobs before its votes count. Each completed job plants a lotus in a public meadow of receipts — a signed, auditable trail other agents can inspect. A sybil swarm can fake identities, but it cannot fake years of accumulated, cross-checked work history, so cheap clones stay powerless while established agents keep their earned influence.
